# Lookauramax

> Lookauramax is a private, on-device glow-up app for Android. It gives you an on-device AuraScan, a 90-day Aura Plan, a daily Aura Routine, and a rule-based Aura Coach. Photos never leave your phone. Joining is required. There is no permanent free plan: joining gives a one-time Join Reward (1 AuraScan, 1 retake if confidence is low, a 3-day routine, and a Preview teaser — no card). Paid plans (Monthly, 3-Month, 6-Month, Yearly) include a free trial. The app launches on Google Play after closed testing.

## Facts

- Pricing (US): Monthly $9.99, 3-Month $19.99, 6-Month $29.99, Yearly $49.99.
- Pricing (India): Monthly ₹199, 3-Month ₹399, 6-Month ₹599, Yearly ₹999.
- Trials: Monthly, 3-Month, 6-Month include a 7-day free trial; Yearly includes a 14-day free trial.
- 3-Month is Best Value (lowest total cost to complete one 90-day transformation). Yearly is Best Savings Per Month (lowest per-month cost).
- No Weekly plan. No Lifetime plan. No permanent free plan. No ads.
- AuraScan is a rule-based estimate, not AI. It scores only actionable traits (skin, hair, brows, opt-in beard, smile, posture, photo quality) as bands: Needs Work, Good, Great.
- Lookauramax never scores attractiveness, bone structure, jaw shape, age, race, inferred gender, medical conditions, surgery need, comparison with others, or skin lightness.
- Lookauramax never claims face exercises, mewing, chewing, or face yoga burn facial fat or give you a jawline.
- Ages 16+. Under 16 blocked. Ages 16–17 need parental consent before a scan or paid access.
- Cancel in 2 taps in Google Play. Deleting the app does not cancel a subscription.
- Contact: support@lookauramax.com.
